collections.title: AegisLayer Core
collections.description: Primary entry points for the public AegisLayer architecture program.
collections.purpose: Give first-time visitors a complete, accurate path through the organization-home Space, documentation, datasets, and SDK.
collections.audience: Platform architects, security leads, governance teams, and technical evaluators.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Only public canonical artifacts that explain the full AegisLayer scope.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No drafts without public context, no speculative external claims, no redundant mirrors.
collections.update_process: Refresh on releases, new Spaces, or major documentation expansions.

collections.title: AI Governance
collections.description: Artifacts focused on policy, accountability, review, and lifecycle control.
collections.purpose: Help governance and assurance readers navigate policy-centric materials quickly.
collections.audience: Governance leads, policy engineers, compliance architects.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Governance-relevant docs, datasets, and Spaces with explicit scope boundaries.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No generalized AI news posts or unrelated tooling.
collections.update_process: Refresh when governance docs, scenarios, or approval flows change.

collections.title: AI Security and Zero Trust
collections.description: Threat, control, runtime, and trust-boundary materials for secure AI execution patterns.
collections.purpose: Collect the security-relevant slice of the public corpus in one place.
collections.audience: Security engineers, threat modelers, zero-trust architects.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Artifacts that explain secure execution boundaries and control rationale.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No speculative vulnerability claims or unverifiable incident examples.
collections.update_process: Refresh when threat mappings, security docs, or related Spaces change.

collections.title: Agentic AI Runtime Governance
collections.description: Execution-state, connector, revocation, and containment materials for agentic systems.
collections.purpose: Show how runtime posture is governed after an action is proposed.
collections.audience: Runtime engineers, agent platform teams, operations architects.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Artifacts that explain runtime transitions, connector trust, and fail-closed behavior.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No unrelated model-hosting or chatbot UX content.
collections.update_process: Refresh when runtime diagrams, connector material, or simulators change.

collections.title: Evidence and Auditability
collections.description: Evidence-chain, traceability, and reviewability assets for accountable AI execution.
collections.purpose: Support teams that need to study how decisions become reviewable records.
collections.audience: Audit teams, assurance engineers, security review leads.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Artifacts that explain evidence record creation, correlation, causation, and review.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No unverifiable claims about tamper-proof guarantees outside documented scope.
collections.update_process: Refresh when evidence docs or related Spaces change.

collections.title: Human Approval and Accountability
collections.description: Approval-path materials for high-impact actions and accountable human review.
collections.purpose: Provide a direct route into approval lifecycle content and related scenarios.
collections.audience: Risk owners, governance leads, operators, human-review program designers.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Artifacts with direct approval or accountability content.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No unrelated general AI ethics content without execution-governance relevance.
collections.update_process: Refresh when approval flows, governance wording, or approval scenarios change.

collections.title: Threat Models and Control Mapping
collections.description: Public threat-model and control-traceability resources with dataset support.
collections.purpose: Bundle the threat-centric material for readers comparing architecture to risk surfaces.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Threat and control artifacts grounded in published docs or datasets.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No penetration-test claims, no external vuln disclosure material.
collections.update_process: Refresh when docs or mappings change.

collections.title: Reference SDK and Developer Resources
collections.description: Reference SDK, examples, and developer-facing public materials.
collections.purpose: Give implementers a single path into SDK and technical reference materials.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Public implementation guidance and conceptual code examples only.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No hidden APIs, no private runtimes, no product-only features.
collections.update_process: Refresh when the SDK or implementation guidance changes.

collections.title: Research and Whitepapers
collections.description: Research program artifacts and long-form public thought pieces tied to the architecture scope.
collections.purpose: Curate the exploratory and whitepaper-oriented side of the program.
collections.audience: Researchers, technical writers, partner evaluators, interested practitioners.
collections.inclusion_criteria: Public research planning or whitepaper-style artifacts grounded in repository references.
collections.exclusion_criteria: No fabricated benchmarks, endorsements, or adoption claims.
collections.update_process: Refresh when research scope, notes, or long-form public artifacts change.
